DIAGNOSIS READY: Mallet Finger (Extensor Lag of the Distal Interphalangeal Joint).

The mechanism of injury (jerky pull on the finger) combined with your inability to actively flex the distal joint and the finger resting in an extended position is classic for a ruptured extensor tendon. While you requested a specific diagnosis in your text, that does not match your clinical presentation of finger injury; Pyelonephritis is a kidney infection unrelated to your symptoms.
